name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 34 – Am 22
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 34. Notes that the removal of remaining tariffs on agri-food products may benefit large exporters while increasing pressure on smaller farmers in the EU and Mexico by favouring export-oriented, large-scale production; warns that the cumulative effect of successive trade agreements risks market destabilisation, downward pressure on prices and further challenges for farm incomes; calls on the Commission to ensure reciprocity of standards, strengthened pesticide controls and full compliance with EU standards for food safety, animal and plant health, and environmental and consumer protection; stresses that trade policy should support farmers’ livelihoods, sustainable agriculture and food sovereignty;
